correctness.rationale: The excluded-jump killing rate is exactly c_k(S)=sum_{unordered occupied pairs}(q_uv+q_vu). Full path law equality forces the Feynman--Kac exponential path integral constant. Strictly positive conditional jump-time density from any initial set along any finite exclusion path implies equality of killing rates along each adjacent transition; irreducible token graph propagates globally. The all fixed-cardinality subset sums lemma is valid for exactly 2<=k<=n-2, while the complement formula covers k=n-1. Analytical proof establishes all quantifiers, including one horizon from one start. 22,872 finite assertions independently support but do not replace it.

value.rationale: An exact, motivated classification answers when hard conditioning on collision avoidance can be replaced *without bias* by ordinary exclusion on any finite connected graph. The one-hole exceptional weighted-regular family differs structurally and sharply from rigid complete-uniform networks with two or more vacant vertices; the equivalence at one starting state and one horizon makes the criterion particularly strong. It treats nonreversible oriented splits and sparse networks, not arbitrary parameters or a table recomputation.
